title: Season 2 finale: the fox's illusion and the Great Shaman's bargain
summary: Gui Li and Lu Xueqi clash with full force. He tells her he can never go back. As Fen Xiang moves in for the kill, Xiao Bai steps in, mocking the pair for being so tragic, and is recognised as the nine-tailed demon fox. She holds off the Fen Xiang disciples with illusion magic. Fa Xiang uses the Great Brahma Prajna to keep Gui Li from being killed. Lu Xueqi learns that Li Xun struck Gui Li's right shoulder with his jade mallet while he was off guard, and coldly praises his 'technique', while she regrets not arriving sooner to save the burning village. Xiao Bai carries the wounded Gui Li to safety and asks whether he prefers that girl or Bi Yao. He says he owes Bi Yao his life. Shangguan Ce reappears after vanishing for the night and sends everyone back to the valley without explaining. A few days later the Great Shaman, who survived, agrees to try to save Gui Li's friend. In return he asks Gui Li, who holds the Mystic Fire Mirror, to protect the Golden Clan when disaster comes, because their stolen holy artifact is the key to waking the demon king of Southern Border legend.
